1.

Instant petition has been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. seeking grant of anticipatory bail in:-
FIR Dated Police Station Sections No. 129 28.07.2023 Mataur, District SAS 406, 420 and 120-B IPC Nagar.

1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:162546 CRM-M-46892-2023 2023:PHHC:162546 2. Upon instructions received from ASI Dilbag Singh, State counsel submits that though the petitioner has joined but recovery of money is yet to be effected from her.
3. Counsel appearing for the complainant also supports the statement made by State counsel.
Petition seeking bail cannot be converted into recovery proceedings nor can a condition be imposed for deposit of alleged embezzled amount.
The interim order passed by this Court, therefore deserves to be confirmed.

6. In view of the above, but without commenting upon the merits of the allegations,
petition is allowed.
Order dated 22.09.2023 is made absolute, subject to satisfaction of conditions laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
